title: situation.confederate_protection_act.title
railroad: the Confederate Congress's act of 21 May for the protection of certain Indian tribes, which precedes every treaty; its Congress is not modelled, so the act comes on its date, independent of either principal's choices

citations.at: p. 289 (the Creek treaty's preamble recites "An act for the protection of certain Indian tribes," approved 21 May 1861) and p. 290 (Art. IV); the act itself is not printed in the volume
